capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Honda Prologue uses the same GM Ultium 85 kWh pack as the Equinox EV (85 kWh usable, 89 gross, Auto-data) and the Optiq (Wikipedia: 85.0 kWh usable); Wikipedia states only "85 kWh". Years compared: 2024-2026; no pack change found.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: Optiq 85 kWh Ultium NMC (GM calls the cells NCMA); same cells across Ultium. Closest enum nmc.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: Optiq has a 400 V architecture; Equinox EV 85 kWh pack ~290 V modules in the 400 V class (InsideEVs).

preconditioning.notes: Wikipedia: Google Maps can start battery preconditioning automatically when routing to a charger. No manual control found.

dc_max_kw.notes: Wikipedia: "capable of up to 155 kW peak during DC fast charging". The shared Ultium 85 kWh pack is 150 kW on Chevrolet/Cadillac (conflict of 5 kW).

ac_max_kw.notes: Charge Port and Wikipedia: up to 11.5 kW (48 A) home charging; no 19.2 kW option found. Applies to US and Canada.
